These answers summarize PikoBuy’s public guide and policies in plain English. They are information, not a guarantee of a product, seller, route or customs result.
How can I start an order with PikoBuy?
PikoBuy says users can search by keyword or submit a product link. Its homepage also says users may submit a link, image or sourcing request. The beginner guide then asks the user to select the specification, colour, size and quantity before making the first payment.
Does the first payment include international shipping?
Not necessarily. PikoBuy’s public order flow shows product purchasing first, then international shipping after items arrive at the warehouse and the user submits a parcel. Plan for these as separate costs.
What does PikoBuy say it checks at the warehouse?
Its guide says warehouse staff check items in, provide photos and perform a defect check. Its homepage also describes quality inspection and repacking. Treat photos as a chance to check visible details, rather than a guarantee of every product characteristic.
Can I ask for different packaging?
PikoBuy’s guide says users can add requests such as minimal packaging or reinforced packaging. Choose based on the product and your own cost-versus-protection preference; packaging choices can affect parcel size or weight.
How is an international shipping estimate calculated?
The official estimate page asks for a country or region, product type, weight, length, width and height. Routes differ in delivery time and billing method, so an estimate should be used for planning rather than treated as a fixed final quote.
When should tracking information appear?
PikoBuy’s beginner guide says tracking information will be available within three days after a parcel is shipped. International deliveries can take longer, so check the ship status and allow that stated window before judging a quiet tracking record.
Who carries the international parcel?
PikoBuy’s shipping terms say parcels are carried by third-party logistics providers. The same terms say cross-border risks, including customs-policy changes and uncontrollable logistics events, cannot be fully removed.
Can I return an item after it reaches the warehouse?
PikoBuy’s returns policy describes a five-day application window after an order becomes “In Warehouse,” subject to seller eligibility and resale-condition requirements. Some items, including certain customised, second-hand, intimate or opened goods, may not qualify.
What can a no-fault return cost?
The published policy says an unconditional return can include the return shipping cost, the seller’s original shipping fee and an RMB 5 service fee. The actual outcome also depends on seller rules and whether the item qualifies.
Is this the official PikoBuy website?
No. This is an independent FindSpreadsheet companion. It does not sell products, represent PikoBuy or promise that a particular seller, item, shipping route, customs outcome or return request will succeed.
